mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1600 units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1600, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.1% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 0.1% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 6.0%, signaling a tight labor market, and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 in a month, the combined effect predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as a strong labor market boosts economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average, indicating supply chain resilience, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as manufacturers' ability to meet demand boosts investor confidence.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when INDPRO > 6-month MA are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annual growth rate (GDPC1) below 2%, signaling sluggish demand, predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as reduced economic activity dampens corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when GDPC1 annual growth < 2%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 1.5% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) growth exceeds 3% over the past 6 months, the combined effect predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as higher interest rates and inflation erode profit margins.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a single month, signaling labor market weakness, predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as investors react to the surprise with risk aversion.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns when UNRATE increases > 0.5% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consistent year-over-year growth in retail sales (RSAFS) above 5%, indicating robust consumer spending, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as strong demand supports economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when RSAFS YoY growth > 5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
